row.body: The storage key is attached to a list that marks the units empty, although a handwritten note asks for another count before the hospital run.
row.title: Storage access list

sidecar.gloss: A storage inventory says empty while a second count is still requested.
sidecar.rival_reading: A supply clerk could have requested a recount before a field transfer; the list does not say who was inside.

row.body: a broken barrier board crushed the magnifying glass against the folded road map. clean undersides show both were there before the road was blocked.
row.title: missing count beside the magnifying glass

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
